name: Ningbo Jansen Superconducting Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Jansen Superconducting Technologies Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of core components for medical magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) equipment in China and internationally. The company offers superconducting magnets, permanent magnets, and gradient coils.
